item.title: Briefing — Wednesday 25 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Tonight is a clear seventy-two degrees, Thursday reaches seventy-nine, Friday seventy-two, and Saturday dawn dips to fifty-five. For Boca Raton that is a cold snap, so you will dig out a jacket for fifty-five degrees and describe it as brutal to everyone you…
